description: Foundation: initialise shadcn/ui (New York, CSS variables) for Tailwind v4 + Next 15 App Router + TS strict, reusing the existing @/* alias, and wire shadcn dark mode to the app's EXISTING data-theme attribute strategy so the current theme toggle keeps working. Add exactly the shadcn primitives the dashboard needs. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 and must not remove the HIG tokens that untouched public/admin/account surfaces still depend on.
steps: Run `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init` in the worktree root. Answer: style = New York; CSS variables = yes; base color = neutral; Tailwind v4; React Server Components = yes; components alias @/components; ui alias @/components/ui; utils @/lib/utils; lib @/lib; icon library = lucide (already a dependency). REUSE the existing @/* alias from tsconfig.json — do NOT reconfigure it.

Verify init created components.json and lib/utils.ts (exporting `cn`), installed clsx + tailwind-merge + class-variance-authority + tw-animate-css (check package.json), and merged shadcn token layers (:root / .dark and @theme inline) into app/globals.css. Confirm it did NOT delete the existing HIG @theme block or the --surface/--label/--tint/--radius-*/--text-* tokens and the existing [data-theme='light']/[data-theme='dark'] blocks — those must remain for public/admin/account.

In app/globals.css add a custom dark variant so shadcn tokens follow this app's attribute strategy instead of the never-set .dark class: `@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] *));`. Place it near the top after `@import 'tailwindcss';`.

Define shadcn's dark token values (the --background/--foreground/--card/--primary/--border/--ring/etc. that init wrote under .dark) under BOTH `:root[data-theme="dark"]` AND `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){ :root:not([data-theme="light"]) }`, mirroring exactly how globals.css already resolves the HIG tokens for the three states (explicit light, explicit dark, system). The default (light) shadcn token values stay on :root. Do not leave a bare `.dark { ... }` block as the only source of dark tokens, because this app never sets that class.
Do NOT edit components/theme-toggle.tsx or components/theme-script.tsx. Confirm by reading them that they still only set/remove the data-theme attribute.

Run `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add button card badge table input label select tabs dropdown-menu separator skeleton sheet dialog sonner sidebar`. Inspect each generated components/ui/*.tsx: they must compile under TS strict and reference the custom dark variant (no reliance on a .dark class this app never sets). If sonner's Toaster is used later, it will be mounted in FEAT-002's dashboard layout, not the root layout.
acceptance_criteria: components.json exists and configures New York style, cssVariables true, tailwind v4, rsc true, aliases pointing at @/components, @/components/ui, @/lib/utils, @/lib.
lib/utils.ts exists and exports a working `cn` helper; clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority and tw-animate-css appear in package.json dependencies.

app/globals.css still contains the original HIG tokens (--surface, --label, --tint, --radius-card, --text-title1, the [data-theme='light'/'dark'] blocks) AND a `@custom-variant dark` matching [data-theme="dark"], AND shadcn dark token values defined for both [data-theme="dark"] and the system (prefers-color-scheme: dark, not [data-theme="light"]) case.
components/ui/ contains button, card, badge, table, input, label, select, tabs, dropdown-menu, separator, skeleton, sheet, dialog, sonner and sidebar, all type-checking.
`pnpm build` compiles and public (non-dashboard) pages render with their existing HIG appearance unchanged.
verification: Manual: run `pnpm dev`, open a dashboard route, toggle the theme light -> dark -> system and confirm shadcn-styled elements recolour in all three states; confirm a public page (app/[locale]/b/** or home) looks unchanged.
findings:
DONE. All verification green: `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` clean (after `prisma generate` — the ungenerated Prisma client is the ONLY source of tsc errors on a fresh worktree, unrelated to this feature), `pnpm lint` clean (one PRE-EXISTING warning in app/actions/auth.ts, not ours), `pnpm build` compiled + 86/86 static pages across en/el/ru.

DEVIATION FROM THE WRITTEN STEPS (approved by parent session as Option C / hybrid): the live shadcn registry migrated in 2026 and no longer serves the classic New-York output this feature's steps assumed. BOTH the latest CLI (4.23.0) and a pinned shadcn@2.10.0 now fetch components that `import { cn } from "cn"` (new standalone `cn` npm package) and `import { Slot } from "radix-ui"` (unified package), and neither creates lib/utils.ts, installs the classic dep triplet, nor merges base token layers. `shadcn init` itself fails at the registry step with `Validation failed: - css: Invalid input` (registry schema drift); `shadcn add` works. So init was done by hand + `shadcn add`.

WHAT FEAT-002/003 MUST DO (locked conventions):
- Import cn from '@/lib/utils' (NOT from 'cn'). lib/utils.ts exports cn = twMerge(clsx(inputs)). Every component created by `shadcn add` ships `import { cn } from "cn"` — you MUST rewrite that one import line to '@/lib/utils' after each add. The `cn` and `next-themes` packages have been REMOVED from package.json; do not reintroduce them.
- Import Radix primitives from the UNIFIED 'radix-ui' package (e.g. `import { Slot } from "radix-ui"`), NOT '@radix-ui/react-*'. This is accepted as-is per Option C.
- deps added: clsx ^2.1.1, tailwind-merge ^3.7.0, class-variance-authority ^0.7.1, tw-animate-css ^1.4.0, radix-ui ^1.8.1, sonner ^2.0.8. lucide-react already present.

EXACT shadcn config (components.json, repo root): style new-york, rsc true, tsx true, tailwind.css app/globals.css, tailwind.baseColor neutral, tailwind.cssVariables true, iconLibrary lucide, aliases components @/components, ui @/components/ui, utils @/lib/utils, lib @/lib, hooks @/hooks.

Primitives in components/ui/: button, card, badge, table, input, label, select, tabs, dropdown-menu, separator, skeleton, sheet, dialog, sonner, sidebar, tooltip (tooltip pulled in as a sidebar dependency). hooks/use-mobile.ts also added (sidebar dep).

DARK-MODE WIRING (the key integration detail):
- globals.css line 11: `@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme='dark'], [data-theme='dark'] *));` — this drives shadcn `dark:*` UTILITY classes off the app's data-theme attribute. It intentionally matches ONLY explicit data-theme='dark' (not system), mirroring the existing HIG utility behaviour. Note the attribute selector uses SINGLE quotes to match the file's existing style.
- shadcn base token VALUES (neutral oklch set: --background/--foreground/--card/--popover/--primary/--secondary/--muted/--accent/--destructive/--border/--input/--ring/--chart-1..5/--radius + full --sidebar-*): light values on :root; dark values duplicated into BOTH `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){ :root }` AND `:root[data-theme='dark']`, so tokens auto-flip for the SYSTEM case and for explicit dark — exactly how the HIG tokens resolve. The CLI's bogus bare `.dark {}` block was removed; the CLI's hsl sidebar tokens were replaced with the canonical neutral oklch values.
- `@theme inline` at end of globals.css maps every shadcn token to a Tailwind utility (--color-background, --color-foreground, --color-border, --color-ring, --radius-sm/md/lg/xl, all --color-sidebar-*) so bg-background / text-foreground / border-border / ring-ring / rounded-lg etc. all generate.
- NO global `@layer base` resetting body bg/color was added — public/admin/account surfaces keep their HIG `html,body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--label)}`. shadcn components colour themselves via utility classes. FEAT-002/003: style dashboard with shadcn utilities; do not add a global body reset.

sonner.tsx was rewired away from next-themes to read the app's data-theme attribute (MutationObserver on <html>, defaults to 'system'); next-themes removed. Mount <Toaster/> in FEAT-002's dashboard layout (NOT the root layout) as the steps note.

UNTOUCHED (confirmed): components/theme-toggle.tsx and components/theme-script.tsx still only set/remove the data-theme attribute. All original HIG tokens (--surface/--label/--tint/--radius-card/--text-title1, the [data-theme='light'|'dark'] blocks, brand-scope, glass, map) remain in globals.css for public/admin/account. .kiro/steering/*.md untouched.
